attributes.title: CAPNI Annual Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Noblesville Indianapolis Conference Center
attributes.organizer: Coalition of Advanced Practice Registered Nurses of Indiana
attributes.summary:
CAPNI now lists its 2027 conference as Tuesday to Thursday, February 23 to 25, in Noblesville: badge pick-up and a welcome reception on Tuesday, with the educational sessions on Wednesday and Thursday. CAPNI is still filling in the agenda, and sessions include breakfast product theaters, so note which hours are CE and which are industry programs.

The page promises CE, but the number of contact hours is not published yet. The $467 member early-bird rate is tied to registering by October 31, 2026; the standard member price for November 1 to February 14 was not shown when we checked. The discounted hotel block is held until January 24, 2027.
